## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Western-Qín version of the *Śyāmaka-jātaka*, by [聖堅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%96%E5%A0%85) Shèngjiān. Signature: 「西秦沙門聖堅奉詔譯」. Together with the two further recensions [T175b](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0028) and [T175c](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0029) this constitutes the three Taishō witnesses to Shèngjiān's Chinese rendering of the *Śyāmaka* narrative — the same translation transmitted in slightly different textual recensions across the *Korean*, *Sòng*, *Yuán*, and *Míng* canonical traditions, distinguished in the Taishō by the suffix-letters 175a / 175b / 175c.

**Abstract**

T175a is the *Korean*-canon recension of Shèngjiān's *Śyāmaka-jātaka* translation, datable to the Western-Qín period 388–431. The Indic source is the *Sāmajātaka* / *Śyāmaka-jātaka* (Pāli *Jātaka* no. 540). The doublet relationship between this recension and [the anonymous T174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0026) has been one of the standard test-cases for studying the catalog-history of *Śyāmaka*-translations into Chinese.

For broader context on the *Śyāmaka-jātaka* narrative and its East-Asian reception, see [T174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0026).
